test_title: PYST 50: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north.

No one sits to the left of P. Only four people sit between P and Q. Only three people sit to the right of Y. X sits to the immediate left of R. W is not an immediate neighbour of Y.

Who sits third to the left of W?
solution:
O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north.

No one sits to the left of P.

Only four people sit between P and Q.

Only three people sit to the right of Y.

X sits immediately to the left of R.

W is not an immediate neighbour of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c5054ad0cdf628ead3059e34495bb7a2dd0f36f1683bbb83dff9849e888e6b8.png] 

Third to the left of W = Y

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
